On Mon, Nov 22, 2021 at 1:51 PM Daniel Stolkowski <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Leo,
I just finished another Google Meeting with Dr. Rogers to be sure that he knows we want a talk on
Disinformation + Authoritarianism .....and what we (private citizens) can do about it. I also made sure that he
didn't use this talk as an opportunity to sell us something and/or bash any "competitors" out there.
[opaque block] 1/3

[opaque block] Google Vault - Re: The next guest speaker
He mentionedthat other government agencies(e.g.,the Naval Postgraduate School) have provided him a
speaker fee/honorarium. He said they paid him $1000 for his presentation. I mentioned we likely could not match
that dollar amount, but I would ask.
What do you think? Can we offer him a smaller honorarium for this webinar? I think something under $500 would
be a fair offer. I could also try to see if my contacts in DDI (Digital Apex) might want to co-sponsor this.
Let me know your thoughts.
Thanks,
Daniel

Disinformation and its relationship with authoritarianism. This would tie in USAID's work on Non Permissive

On Sun, Nov 14, 2021 at 9:29PM Leo Ruth <[contact omitted]> wrote:
What topic do you think he should discuss during the webinar?

On Sun, Nov 14, 2021 at 9:11 PM Daniel Stolkowski <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Leo,
I'd like to run this by you ...and then have you present the idea to John.
As you know, the SEC Guest Speaker Series aims to help USAID better understand security-related
issues impacting our work. Our speakers so far this year have been Peter Lord, VP of Strategic
Initiatives [contact omitted] Oracle; Jonathan Hillman from the Reconnecting Asia Project at CSIS;
and we also hosted the authors of this paper from RAND.
For our next talk, I would like to invite Dr. Danny Rogers. I have known him since the days I worked for
the U.S.Army (INSCOM) and he worked atthe Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory.
Danny is a physicist, an author, and an expert in cryptography, cybercrime, disinformation, and
security. He currently teaches in the Cybercrime and Global Security Masters Program at New York
[opaque block] 2/3

[opaque block] Google Vault - Re: The next guest speaker
University's Center for Global Affairs and is a Security Fellow at the Truman Project on National
Security. He currently works at the Global Disinformation Index. I've seen some of his webinars, and I
think he's a good web-speaker. (That's him speaking in the video.) He recently also testified on the
subject at the U.S. Capital.
I've reached out to him, and he could be available to do a custom webinar for USAID some time in mid
December.
Let me know if I should continue to pursue this. As I did with Peter Lord and the RAND team, I'll do all
the behind the scenes work (notification to USAID staff, prep slides with the speaker, write up an intro,
post the recording on the SEC website, etc.).
Let me know if/when I get the green light for this.
Thanks,
Daniel
[opaque block] 3/3
